note: Programmes are curated. CIP codes are PREFIXES and are matched as such; many CIP codes are supported by more than one programme.

programs.name: Nursing
programs.description: Nursing programmes prepare people to care for patients across every setting Florida has, from a practical-nursing certificate at a technical college through an associate degree leading to RN licensure to a baccalaureate and beyond. One programme, several entry points.
programs.degreesNote: Nursing encompasses several degrees, and the level you enter at is the real decision. A PRACTICAL NURSING certificate leads to LPN licensure and is the fastest route into paid clinical work. An ASSOCIATE degree leads to RN licensure through NCLEX-RN. A BACCALAUREATE (BSN) leads to the same licence by a longer route, and is what many hospitals prefer and what graduate study requires. ⚠ An RN-to-BSN programme is for nurses who are ALREADY licensed and does not lead to initial licensure. Many Florida institutions offer more than one of these.

cips.note: Registered nursing, nursing administration, research and clinical nursing — the A.S. and BSN routes to RN licensure.
Practical and vocational nursing, and nursing assistants — the LPN and CNA routes. ⚠ Included deliberately: a school with only an LPN programme has a nursing programme.

programs.name: Engineering Technology
programs.description: Engineering technology programmes prepare technicians and technologists who build, install, test and maintain what engineers design — electronics, mechanical systems, industrial automation, quality, drafting and civil works. It is the largest applied-technical family in the Florida College System.
programs.degreesNote: Engineering Technology is mostly an ASSOCIATE-level family in Florida, with a smaller number of BACHELOR degrees and a large number of short certificates that stack toward them. ⚠⚠ It is NOT the same as an ENGINEERING degree, and the difference is worth two years: under s. 471.013(1)(a), Florida Statutes, a graduate of an approved engineering curriculum needs four years of experience before the PE examination, while a graduate of an approved engineering technology curriculum needs six. If a PE licence is your goal, read the Mechanical Engineer career path first.

cips.note: The whole Engineering Technologies series — 32 CIP codes are awarded in Florida, from sub-year certificates to master’s degrees.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering
programs.description: Mechanical engineering programmes teach the analysis of forces, motion, energy and materials, and the design of the machines and systems that use them. It is the broadest engineering discipline and the one that closes the fewest doors.
programs.degreesNote: Here the programme and the major are the same thing: a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it. ⚠ For Professional Engineer licensure the degree must come from a programme accredited by ABET’s ENGINEERING commission — check before enrolling, because an engineering TECHNOLOGY accreditation adds two years to the experience requirement.

cips.note: General engineering, where several Florida institutions place a first year common to all engineering majors.

programs.name: Chemical Engineering
programs.description: Chemical engineering programmes teach the design and operation of processes that transform materials at scale — reactors, separations, heat and mass transfer, process control and process safety. It is the engineering discipline built on chemistry, and the only one that requires organic chemistry. ⚠⚠ In Florida it is offered at only FOUR institutions in THREE cities, and two of those four share one joint college, so where you start matters more here than in any other engineering discipline.
programs.degreesNote: The programme and the major are the same thing: a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it. Several programmes brand it chemical and biomolecular engineering, which is the same degree with a bioprocess emphasis. ⚠ ABET accreditation under the ENGINEERING commission is what employers screen on and what carries the four-year route to Professional Engineer licensure — verify the specific programme by name.

cips.note: Chemical Engineering — the degree itself. All Florida awards fall under 14.0701.
General engineering, where several Florida institutions place a first year common to all engineering majors.

programs.name: Biomedical Engineering
programs.description: Biomedical engineering programmes apply engineering to medicine — instrumentation and imaging, biomaterials and implants, biomechanics, and tissue and neural engineering. It is Florida’s newest and fastest-growing engineering discipline. ⚠⚠ It is also the one where the bachelor’s degree is least often the end of the story: fewer than half of employers treat it as sufficient, and two Florida universities award the degree at graduate level only.
programs.degreesNote: The programme and the major are the same thing: a Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it. Some programmes brand it bioengineering, which is the same degree. ⚠⚠ UNLIKE MOST PROGRAMMES IN THIS REPOSITORY, THE GRADUATE DEGREES ARE NOT OPTIONAL EXTRAS — UCF and FAU offer them without any bachelor’s, and O*NET reports 26% of employers requiring a master’s and 13% a doctorate. ⚠ Check ABET accreditation under the ENGINEERING commission, not engineering technology.

cips.note: Biomedical/Medical Engineering — the degree itself. All Florida awards fall under 14.0501.
General engineering, where several Florida institutions place a first year common to all engineering majors.
